# weapp.dev reference

weapp.dev hosts tools for real mini-app repos. weapp-tailwindcss handles styles, weapp-vite handles builds, and Varo documents planned editable component delivery boundaries. Adopt the released tools separately or together. The Chinese homepage is https://weapp.dev/ and the English homepage is https://weapp.dev/en/. The site is maintained by sonofmagic and contributors. The source repository is https://github.com/sonofmagic/weapp.dev.

## weapp-tailwindcss

- Canonical Chinese page: https://weapp.dev/projects/weapp-tailwindcss/
- Canonical English page: https://weapp.dev/en/projects/weapp-tailwindcss/
- Documentation: https://tw.weapp.dev/
- Source: https://github.com/sonofmagic/weapp-tailwindcss
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/weapp-tailwindcss
- Install: `pnpm add -D weapp-tailwindcss`
- Purpose: Tailwind CSS v4 generation, exact class transforms, runtime values, and platform-aware styling across mini-app and cross-platform targets.
- Audience: Frontend teams working across WeChat, Alipay, Douyin, Taro, uni-app, or related mini-app targets.

## weapp-vite

- Canonical Chinese page: https://weapp.dev/projects/weapp-vite/
- Canonical English page: https://weapp.dev/en/projects/weapp-vite/
- Documentation: https://vite.weapp.dev/
- Source: https://github.com/weapp-vite/weapp-vite
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/weapp-vite
- Install: `pnpm add -D weapp-vite`
- Purpose: Vite-powered development, builds, runtime tooling, and verification for mini-apps, including Vue SFC, automatic routing, Wevu, screenshots, and multi-platform output.
- Targets: WeChat, Alipay, Douyin, Baidu, Kuaishou mini-apps, and Web.

## Varo

- Canonical Chinese page: https://weapp.dev/projects/varo/
- Canonical English page: https://weapp.dev/en/projects/varo/
- Documentation and source: https://github.com/daguanren21/Varo#readme
- Purpose: Planned Registry, editable UI source, theme token, business block, and Agent UI boundaries for H5 and weapp-vite mini-programs.
- Release status: planned; package metadata, install instructions, runtime capabilities, and performance data are not published yet.

## VPT (vite-plugin-taro)

- Canonical Chinese page: https://weapp.dev/projects/vite-plugin-taro/
- Canonical English page: https://weapp.dev/en/projects/vite-plugin-taro/
- Documentation: https://vpt.js.org/
- Source: https://github.com/sep2/vite-plugin-taro
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vite-plugin-taro
- Create a project: `npm create vite-taro@latest my-app`
- Install the plugin: `npm install -D vite-plugin-taro`; follow the documentation to configure Vite and project entries.
- Purpose: Build WeChat, Alipay, and Web apps from one React/Taro codebase using Vite 8, React 19, and Taro 4, with state-preserving hot reload, automatic WeChat subpackages, Tailwind CSS v4, and WeChat Skyline support.
- Audience: React teams that want to reuse Taro components and APIs with a modern Vite workflow.
- Targets: WeChat (`wx`), Alipay (`zfb`), and Web (`h5`).
- Relationship to Taro: VPT uses Taro components, APIs, and runtime with Vite-powered development and builds instead of the older webpack pipeline.
- Getting started: Use the project generator for a new app or follow https://vpt.js.org/guides/migrate-from-taro/ for an existing Taro app.

Use the canonical project pages and linked official sources as the authority for current versions, APIs, compatibility, and release details.

## Delivery and sponsorship

The delivery page at https://weapp.dev/pricing/ describes what can be delivered today and what remains on the roadmap. Human-delivered migration and training services are available by discussion. Cloud builds, official templates, and private component registries are still in development. The contributor program at https://weapp.dev/contributors/ explains how confirmed sponsorship is shared with people who land eligible work.

Open-source sponsorship uses one-time permanent recognition tiers: ¥20 supporter, ¥200 Bronze, and ¥1,000 Silver. ¥200 and above may display a GitHub avatar, username, and profile link after GitHub identity confirmation, maintainer review, and explicit authorization. Approved records may be shown on weapp.dev, tw.weapp.dev, and vite.weapp.dev. Gold business partnerships follow icebreaker.top terms: ¥2,000 for one-site monthly advertising, ¥3,000 for dual-site monthly advertising, ¥8,000 for a dual-site quarterly partnership, or custom discussion.

Confirmed open-source sponsorship is split net of payment fees: 60% core maintenance, 25% contributors fund, and 15% nearby open source. The contributors fund pays quarterly thank-you amounts for eligible merged work and optional bounties; if a quarter is under ¥500 it rolls forward. Product revenue such as future Pro, Team, or implementation fees stays out of this fund. Destinations are announced quarterly. Sponsorship is not a purchase of technical support, templates, cloud-build minutes, or subscription access, and public recognition never exposes payment amounts or private ledger data.
